ideas.pitch: A hybrid quantum-classical Variational Quantum Eigensolver using Qiskit to optimize large-scale financial portfolios under market volatility constraints.
ideas.title: VQE-PortfolioOptimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core requirement of building with Qiskit and applying quantum computing to a real-world enterprise problem.

ideas.pitch: Solving complex logistics routing problems by mapping spatial delivery networks to QAOA (Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm) circuits using Qiskit.
ideas.title: QuantumGraphMaxCut
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a heavily relevant algorithmic framework with tangible logistics applications that judges immediately understand.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight quantum chemistry simulation tool built on Qiskit Nature to estimate ground-state energy for simple drug-like molecular structures.
ideas.title: EntangledMoleculeSim
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates domain expertise in quantum simulation, which remains one of the primary near-term value propositions highlighted by quantum judges.

ideas.pitch: An educational visualization and runtime middleware suite that applies noise models and zero-noise extrapolation to noisy Qiskit quantum circuits.
ideas.title: QuantumErrorMitigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses hardware limitations directly, showcasing deep technical competence in dealing with Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum systems.

ideas.pitch: A quantum-classical hybrid neural network utilizing parameterized quantum circuits via Qiskit Machine Learning for high-dimensional anomaly detection.
ideas.title: QML-FraudClassifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges the gap between trending machine learning paradigms and quantum computing architectures, satisfying both technical difficulty and real-world relevance.
